## Validation evidence

Actual command, result, environment, commit, screenshot/video or log summary. Distinguish synthetic/offline replay from actual model execution.

## Safety and rollback

- [ ] Only reviewed allowlisted files; no credentials, raw wires, sealed mappings, live DB or unapproved media.
- [ ] No new paid model calls; production defaults unchanged or explicit opt-in documented.
- [ ] Revert/disable steps and rollback SHA are recorded.
- [ ] Non-author human reviewer has performed the required checks (leave unchecked until true).
